gloss: policy interest rate; the benchmark interest rate set by a central bank to guide monetary policy

definitions.gloss: policy interest rate; the benchmark interest rate set by a central bank to guide monetary policy
definitions.explanation: Used in economics and finance contexts. In Japan, this refers to the rate set by the Bank of Japan.

examples.japanese: {政策金利|せいさくきんり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げられた→引き上げる：05689_hikiageru⟧。
examples.english: The policy interest rate was raised.

examples.japanese: {日本銀行|にほんぎんこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{政策金利|せいさくきんり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{据|す}え{置|お}き→据え置き：18902_sueoki⟧にした。
examples.english: The Bank of Japan kept the policy interest rate unchanged.

examples.japanese: {政策金利|せいさくきんり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦ローン→ローン：06579_roon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える→影響を与える：26072_eikyouwoataeru⟧。
examples.english: Changes in the policy interest rate also affect mortgage interest rates.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧ (policy) and ⟦{金利|きんり}→金利：04856_kinri⟧ (interest rate). This is the interest rate that a country's central bank sets as a primary tool for monetary policy, influencing lending rates, inflation, and economic activity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {政策金利|せいさくきんり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げる→引き上げる：05689_hikiageru⟧: to raise the policy rate
- {政策金利|せいさくきんり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げる→引き下げる：06193_hikisageru⟧: to lower the policy rate
- {政策金利|せいさくきんり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{据|す}え{置|お}く→据え置く：18383_sueoku⟧: to hold the policy rate steady
- {政策金利|せいさくきんり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{決定|けってい}→決定：02701_kettei⟧: policy rate decision
